changes.change: View field extraction strips SQL comments before replacing JOIN and WHERE/GROUP BY/... keywords; the internal markers become __pb_join__/__pb_discard__.
changes.importer_input: _collections.schema of view collections, regenerated when a view is saved. The importer imports no view row and compares view definitions with the export without their random field IDs.
changes.effect: None for BUMA: 4 of the 42 views contain '--' comments, but both binaries extract identical view schemas (binary comparison) that match the export.

changes.change: JS migrations, hooks, cron and route handlers are compiled with <cwd>/pb.js as script path so that require() walks parent node_modules.
changes.importer_input: None: module resolution of JS code, not stored data.
changes.effect: None on storage; fixtures migrations run unchanged on both binaries.

changes.change: Normalized serialization of error attributes in log entries.
changes.importer_input: logs.db only, which is never imported.

changes.change: OIDC userinfo email_verified accepted as int or boolean string.
changes.importer_input: None: OAuth2 login only (_externalAuths is empty and no OAuth2 provider is enabled in the real settings).

changes.effect: None observed in the binary comparison.

entries: (_Backported from v0.26.6_) Allow OIDC `email_verified` to be int or boolean string since some OIDC providers like AWS Cognito has non-standard userinfo response
(_Backported from v0.26.3_) Fixed and normalized logs error serialization across common types for more consistent logs error output
(_Backported from v0.26.2_) Updated `golang-jwt/jwt` dependency because it comes with a [minor security fix](https://github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/security/advisories/GHSA-mh63-6h87-95cp).
(_Backported from v0.25.5_) Set the current working directory as a default goja script path when executing inline JS strings to allow `require(m)` traversing parent `node_modules` directories.
(_Backported from v0.24.4_) Fixed fields extraction for view queries with nested comments
Bumped GitHub action min Go version to 1.23.5 as it comes with some [minor security fixes](https://github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.23.5).
(_Backported from v0.23.11_) Upgraded `golang.org/x/net` to 0.33.0 to fix [CVE-2024-45338](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-45338).
(_Backported from v0.23.10_) Renew the superuser file token cache when clicking on the thumb preview or download link
(_Backported from v0.23.10_) Upgraded `modernc.org/sqlite` to 1.34.3 to fix "disk io" error on arm64 systems.

conclusion.statement: PocketBase v0.22.34 changes none of the code that decides what data.db and storage/ contain (models, models/schema, tools/types, tools/security, tools/filesystem, forms, migrations, core, apis and the record/table/settings daos have identical git objects); its only daos change, daos/view.go, regenerates view schemas and gives the same fields for the 42 BUMA views. Built from the same synthetic fixtures, both official binaries store identical values, rowids, DDL and storage objects, apart from values that are random by design, which keep the same formats; the importer at this commit reads both identically and, measured with 0.22.34 removed from its registry of validated versions (so that this result never depends on the evidence it publishes), only the version gate rejects 0.22.34. The real 0.22.34 backup uses the same formats. Accepting source_version 0.22.34 in scripts/c11_import.py needs no reader change.
